full_query: If this is just muscle strain, how many days should I expect the pain to go away?
sentences: Muscle strain, also known as muscle pull or muscle tear, is a common injury that occurs when a muscle is stretched or torn, causing pain, stiffness, and limited mobility
The duration of muscle strain pain can vary depending on the severity of the injury and the individual's overall health
Generally, the pain from muscle strain can last anywhere from a few days to several weeks or even months
Mild muscle strain may resolve within 1-3 days, while moderate strain may take 7-14 days to heal, and severe strain may take longer than 14 days to recover
According to a study published in the Journal of Pain, the severity of muscle strain can be classified into three stages: acute (0-24 hours), sub-acute (24-72 hours), and chronic (beyond 72 hours)

In this study, the researchers found that the accuracy of expected pain intensity increased during the study, with actual pain intensity accounting for up to 55% of the variance in expected pain intensity
While there is no one-size-fits-all answer to how many days muscle strain pain will last, most people can expect to recover from mild muscle strain within 1-2 weeks
However, it is essential to note that some muscle strains may take longer to heal, and in some cases, may require medical attention
